newsitem.title: UK: Italy Feb fuel use for power falls 16 pct vs yr ag.
newsitem.headline: Italy Feb fuel use for power falls 16 pct vs yr ag.

text.p: Italian consumption of fuel oil for power generation was 1.76 million tonnes in February, 16 percent lower than in the previous year, according to figures to be published on Thursday by industry newsletter Staffetta Quotidiana.

Low sulphur fuel oil use was down 21.5 percent in February at 1.29 million tonnes while high sulphur fuel consumption was 4.3 percent higher year-on-year at 463,000 tonnes, according to the figures that were obtained by Reuters.
Italian non-power fuel oil consumption was 10.3 percent lower year-on-year in February at 347,000 tonnes.

Data for January were not directly quoted but the report said total consumption for power use in January and February combined was down 18 percent at 3.50 million tonnes. Consumption of all fuel for non-power uses was 8.3 percent down in the first two months of the year at 700,000 tonnes.
Analysts attributed the bulk of the falls in consumption to warmer weather this winter compared to last year, as well as increased consumption of natural gas.
